1
五星合聚
Conjunctions of the Five Planets
2
天官書言同舍為合，於兩星、三星、四星、五星之合各有占，而以五星合為最吉，謂經度之同如合朔也。 茲就三星以上同宮同宿，及兩星以上同度者，著於篇。
The Treatise on the Offices of Heaven states that when stars share a lodge it counts as a conjunction; prognostications differ for pairings of two, three, four, or five stars, yet a full conjunction of the five planets is held most auspicious—namely when their ecliptic longitudes coincide as at new moon. This chapter records instances in which three or more stars shared a palace and lodge, and those in which two or more stars shared the same degree.
3
順治元年正月庚戌，土木金聚於降婁兩旬餘。 丙辰，土金同躔壁三度。 三月乙巳，土水同躔壁八度。
The first year of Shunzhi, in the first month, on the day gengxu, Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus gathered at Jianglou for more than twenty days. On the day bingchen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 3° of Bi. In the third month, on the day yisi, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 8° of Bi.
4
二年二月乙亥，金水同躔危一度。 三月庚子，土金水聚於降婁旬餘； 己酉，土水同躔奎七度。 四月壬戌，土金同躔奎九度； 癸酉，木水同躔畢五度。 閏六月己酉，火金水聚於鶉尾。 七月庚申，聚於翼； 丁卯，聚於壽星兩旬； 壬申，聚於軫。 八月癸未，聚於角； 丁酉，聚於亢； 戊戌，聚於大火。
Year 2 of Shunzhi, in the second month, on the day yihai, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 1° of Wei. In the third month, on the day gengzi, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Jianglou for more than ten days; On the day jiyou, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 7° of Kui. In the fourth month, on the day renxu, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 9° of Kui; On the day guiyou, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 5° of Bi (Net). In intercalary sixth month, on the day jiyou, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quewei. In the seventh month, on the day gengshen, they gathered at Yi; On the day dingmao, they gathered at Shouxing for twenty days; On the day renshen, they gathered at Zhen. In the eighth month, on the day guiwei, they gathered at Jiao; On the day dingyou, they gathered at Kang; On the day wuxu, they gathered at Dahuo.
5
三年三月庚戌，土金水聚於大梁旬餘； 壬子，土水同躔婁七度。 四月丁酉，土火金聚於大梁月餘。 五月癸丑，聚於胃旬餘。 六月甲申，木水同躔井十九度。 七月乙丑，木火金聚於鶉首聚於井； 丙寅，木金同躔井二十八度。
Year 3 of Shunzhi, in the third month, on the day gengxu, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Daliang for more than ten days; On the day renzi, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 7° of Lou. In the fourth month, on the day dingyou, Saturn, Mars, and Venus gathered at Daliang for more than a month. In the fifth month, on the day guichou, they gathered at Wei (Stomach) for more than ten days. In the sixth month, on the day jiashen, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 19° of Jing. In the seventh month, on the day yichou, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Queshou, then gathered at Jing; On the day bingyin, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 28° of Jing.
6
四年二月庚子，木火同躔井二十八度。 三月丁未，土金水聚於大梁兩旬； 丙辰，聚於胃，金水同躔胃二度； 戊午，土水同躔胃六度； 庚申，土金同躔胃七度。 六月乙未，木水同躔柳十度。 七月庚申，火金同躔軫五度。 八月己巳，火金水聚於壽星。 十月戊子，聚於析木旬有九日； 癸巳，聚於尾。
Year 4 of Shunzhi, in the second month, on the day gengzi, Jupiter and Mars shared longitude at 28° of Jing. In the third month, on the day dingwei, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Daliang for twenty days; On the day bingchen, they gathered at Wei (Stomach), Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 2° of Wei (Stomach); On the day wuwu, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 6° of Wei (Stomach); On the day gengshen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 7° of Wei (Stomach). In the sixth month, on the day yiwei, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 10° of Liu. In the seventh month, on the day gengshen, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 5° of Zhen. In the eighth month, on the day jisi, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Shouxing. In the tenth month, on the day wuzi, they gathered at Ximu for 19 days; On the day guisi, they gathered at Wei (Tail).
7
五年四月甲午，火金水聚於大梁旬餘，聚於婁。 閏四月乙巳，聚於胃； 丙午，火金同躔胃二度； 丙辰，土水同躔畢四度。 五月丁卯，土火金水聚於實沈，土金同躔畢五度。 七月甲戌，木金水聚於鶉尾兩旬餘，聚於張浹旬。
Year 5 of Shunzhi, in the fourth month, on the day jiawu, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Daliang for more than ten days, they gathered at Lou. In intercalary fourth month, on the day yisi, they gathered at Wei (Stomach); On the day bingwu, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 2° of Wei (Stomach); On the day bingchen, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 4° of Bi (Net). In the fifth month, on the day dingmao, Saturn, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Sishen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 5° of Bi (Net). In the seventh month, on the day jiaxu, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quewei for more than twenty days, they gathered at Zhang for about ten days.
8
六年三月丙寅，土金同躔畢八度。 五月庚申，土水同躔觜一度。 六月辛卯，木火同躔翼十三度。 九月戊午，木水同躔軫十二度。
Year 6 of Shunzhi, in the third month, on the day bingyin, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 8° of Bi (Net). In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 1° of Zi. In the sixth month, on the day xinmao, Jupiter and Mars shared longitude at 13° of Yi. In the ninth month, on the day wuwu, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 12° of Zhen.
9
七年三月壬申，火金水聚於降婁。 四月辛卯，聚於大梁。 五月丁巳，聚於實沈； 癸亥，土水同躔井初度； 乙丑，土金水聚於鶉首旬餘； 乙亥，聚於井旬餘。 六月庚戌，土火水聚於井旬餘； 辛亥，聚於鶉首旬餘。 七月癸丑，土火同躔井七度。 九月辛未，木水同躔氐三度。
Year 7 of Shunzhi, in the third month, on the day renshen, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Jianglou. In the fourth month, on the day xinmao, they gathered at Daliang. In the fifth month, on the day dingsi, they gathered at Sishen; On the day guihai, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at the first degree of Jing; On the day yichou, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou for more than ten days; On the day yihai, they gathered at Jing for more than ten days. In the sixth month, on the day gengxu, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Jing for more than ten days; On the day xinhai, they gathered at Queshou for more than ten days. In the seventh month, on the day guichou, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 7° of Jing. In the ninth month, on the day xinwei, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 3° of Di.
10
八年正月甲子，金水同躔危二度。 四月辛未，土水同躔井十四度。 六月甲寅，土金水聚於鶉首旬餘； 乙卯，聚於井旬餘； 癸酉，土金同躔井二十二度。 八月乙卯，木火同躔心二度。 十月戊辰，木金水聚於析木旬餘； 壬申，木金同躔尾十度。 十一月乙亥朔，木金水聚於尾。 癸卯，火金水聚於元枵。 十二月丁卯，聚於危。
Year 8 of Shunzhi, in the first month, on the day jiazi, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 2° of Wei. In the fourth month, on the day xinwei, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 14° of Jing. In the sixth month, on the day jiayin, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou for more than ten days; On the day yimao, they gathered at Jing for more than ten days; On the day guiyou, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 22° of Jing. In the eighth month, on the day yimao, Jupiter and Mars shared longitude at 2° of Xin. In the tenth month, on the day wuchen, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Ximu for more than ten days; On the day renshen, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 10° of Wei (Tail). In the eleventh month, on the first day of the month (yihai), Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Wei (Tail). On the day guimao, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao. In the twelfth month, on the day dingmao, they gathered at Wei.
11
九年正月己亥，火金同躔壁五度。 四月癸亥，土金水聚於鶉首，聚於井旬餘； 庚午，土金同躔井二十六度。 六月丁卯，土水同躔鬼二度。 七月丁丑，土火水聚於鶉火； 丁亥，土火同躔柳初度。
Year 9 of Shunzhi, in the first month, on the day jihai, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 5° of Bi. In the fourth month, on the day guihai, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou, they gathered at Jing for more than ten days; On the day gengwu, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 26° of Jing. In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 2° of Gui. In the seventh month, on the day dingchou, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Quehuo; On the day dinghai, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at the first degree of Liu.

十年正月壬午，木水同躔牛二度； 壬辰，木金水聚於牛； 癸巳，聚於元枵兩旬餘。 六月癸亥，土金水聚於鶉火旬餘。 閏六月丙寅，聚於柳； 辛未，土水同躔柳九度； 壬申，土金同躔柳九度。 十月丙戌，木火金聚於元枵。 十一月庚子，木金同躔女十度。
Year 10 of Shunzhi, in the first month, on the day renwu, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 2° of Niu; On the day renchen, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Niu; On the day guisi, they gathered at Yuanxiao for more than twenty days. In the sixth month, on the day guihai, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quehuo for more than ten days. In intercalary sixth month, on the day bingyin, they gathered at Liu; On the day xinwei, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 9° of Liu; On the day renshen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 9° of Liu. In the tenth month, on the day bingxu, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Yuanxiao. In the eleventh month, on the day gengzi, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 10° of Nü.

十一年正月己酉，木水同躔危四度。 二月辛巳，火金水聚於大梁旬餘； 己丑，聚於胃。 六月庚午，土火水聚於鶉火； 乙亥，土水同躔星四度。 八月壬戌，土火同躔張二度； 癸酉，土火金水聚於鶉尾旬餘； 丁丑，土金同躔張三度； 乙亥，土火金水聚於張。 九月辛卯，火金同躔翼二度。

In the ninth month, on the day xinmao, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 2° of Yi.

十二年正月乙巳，木金水聚於娵訾； 乙卯，聚於室浹旬。 二月甲子，木金同躔室十四度； 乙丑，木金水聚於降婁兩旬； 戊辰，聚於壁。 六月癸酉，土金同躔張七度； 丙子，土金水聚於鶉尾旬餘； 丁丑，聚於張。 八月乙亥，土水同躔張十四度。
Year 12 of Shunzhi, in the first month, on the day yisi, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Juzi; On the day yimao, they gathered at Shi for about ten days. In the second month, on the day jiazi, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 14° of Shi; On the day yichou, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Jianglou for twenty days; On the day wuchen, they gathered at Bi. In the sixth month, on the day guiyou, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 7° of Zhang; On the day bingzi, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quewei for more than ten days; On the day dingchou, they gathered at Zhang. In the eighth month, on the day yihai, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 14° of Zhang.
15
十三年七月癸亥，土火金水聚於鶉尾旬餘。 八月丙子朔，土金同躔翼七度； 壬辰，土火同躔翼九度。
Year 13 of Shunzhi, in the seventh month, on the day guihai, Saturn, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quewei for more than ten days. In the eighth month, on the first day of the month (bingzi), Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 7° of Yi; On the day renchen, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 9° of Yi.
16
十四年二月庚子，木金同躔畢一度。 六月癸巳，木金水聚於鶉首； 丙申，聚於井。 十月己卯，土金同躔軫八度。
Year 14 of Shunzhi, in the second month, on the day gengzi, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 1° of Bi (Net). In the ninth month, on the day jiwei, the same as before; On the day gengshen, they gathered at Jiao for more than ten days; On the day xinyou, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 3° of Jiao.
18
十六年二月甲戌，金水同躔女八度； 丁丑，火金水聚於元枵。 九月辛巳，土金水聚於大火兩旬。
Year 16 of Shunzhi, in the second month, on the day jiaxu, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 8° of Nü; On the day dingchou, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao. In the ninth month, on the day xinsi, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Dahuo for twenty days.
19
十七年六月癸巳，木火金聚於張旬餘； 戊戌，木金同躔張十一度； 癸丑，木火金水聚於鶉尾兩旬，木火水聚於張。 七月乙卯，木火同躔張十四度； 癸亥，木水同躔張十六度； 壬申，木火金水聚於翼旬餘。 九月己卯，土火水聚於大火旬餘。 十月乙酉，土火同躔氐四度； 丙戌，土火水聚於氐浹旬。 十一月丙子，土金同躔氐十六度。 十二月庚戌，火金水聚於星紀旬餘。
Year 17 of Shunzhi, in the sixth month, on the day guisi, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Zhang for more than ten days; On the day wuxu, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 11° of Zhang; On the day guichou, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quewei for twenty days, Jupiter, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Zhang. In the seventh month, on the day yimao, Jupiter and Mars shared longitude at 14° of Zhang; On the day guihai, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 16° of Zhang; On the day renshen, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yi for more than ten days. In the ninth month, on the day jimao, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Dahuo for more than ten days. In the tenth month, on the day yiyou, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 4° of Di; On the day bingxu, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Di for about ten days. In the eleventh month, on the day bingzi, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 16° of Di. In the twelfth month, on the day gengxu, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Xingji for more than ten days.
20
十八年正月甲寅，聚於鬥； 庚申，火水同躔鬥十九度； 乙亥，火金水聚於元枵。 六月己卯，金水同躔井二度。 閏七月乙巳，木金同躔軫十二度。 八月壬申，土金同躔氐十二度。 九月丁丑朔，土金水聚於大火。
Year 18 of Shunzhi, in the first month, on the day jiayin, they gathered at Dou; On the day gengshen, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 19° of Dou; On the day yihai, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao. In the sixth month, on the day jimao, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 2° of Jing. In intercalary seventh month, on the day yisi, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 12° of Zhen. In the eighth month, on the day renshen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 12° of Di. In the ninth month, on the first day of the month (dingchou), Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Dahuo.
21
康熙元年三月己亥，金水同躔奎八度。 九月甲戌，木火水聚於大火旬餘； 庚辰，聚於氐旬餘； 辛巳，木火同躔氐八度； 乙酉，木水同躔氐九度； 戊子，火水同躔氐十三度。 十月丙午，土火同躔心三度。 十一月辛未朔，五星聚於析木，土金水聚於心； 乙亥，土金同躔心六度； 乙酉，土水同躔尾初度。 十二月庚子朔，火金水聚於星紀旬餘； 甲辰，聚於鬥； 戊申，聚於牛； 甲寅，火金同躔鬥二十二度； 戊午，火金水聚於元枵旬餘。
The first year of Kangxi, in the third month, on the day jihai, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 8° of Kui. In the ninth month, on the day jiaxu, Jupiter, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Dahuo for more than ten days; On the day gengchen, they gathered at Di for more than ten days; On the day xinsi, Jupiter and Mars shared longitude at 8° of Di; On the day yiyou, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 9° of Di; On the day wuzi, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 13° of Di. In the tenth month, on the day bingwu, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 3° of Xin. In the eleventh month, on the first day of the month (xinwei), the five planets gathered at Ximu, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Xin; On the day yihai, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 6° of Xin; On the day yiyou, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at the first degree of Wei (Tail). In the twelfth month, on the first day of the month (gengzi), Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Xingji for more than ten days; On the day jiachen, they gathered at Dou; On the day wushen, they gathered at Niu; On the day jiayin, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 22° of Dou; On the day wuwu, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao for more than ten days.
22
二年二月辛亥，金水同躔壁五度； 戊辰，火水同躔室七度。 九月丙戌，土木同躔尾三度； 甲午，土木金水聚於析木旬餘。 十月乙未朔，土木金聚於尾旬餘。 十一月癸巳，土水同躔尾十度。 十二月戊戌，木水同躔箕三度。
Year 2 of Kangxi, in the second month, on the day xinhai, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 5° of Bi; On the day wuchen, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 7° of Shi. In the ninth month, on the day bingxu, Saturn and Jupiter shared longitude at 3° of Wei (Tail); On the day jiawu, Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Ximu for more than ten days. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month (yiwei), Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus gathered at Wei (Tail) for more than ten days. In the eleventh month, on the day guisi, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 10° of Wei (Tail). In the twelfth month, on the day wuxu, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 3° of Ji.

三年正月壬午，木金同躔鬥三度。 六月丙辰，金水同躔井十度。 八月甲申，火金水聚於大火。 九月戊申，土火金聚於析木兩旬。 十月乙丑，土火同躔箕一度； 庚午，土火金聚於箕； 壬申，木火金聚於星紀兩旬餘； 丁丑，聚於鬥兩旬。 十一月庚寅，木金同躔鬥十六度； 丁酉，土木火水聚於星紀浹旬； 己亥，木火水聚於鬥，木火同躔鬥十八度； 壬子，火金水聚於元枵； 丁巳，火水同躔女一度。 十二月丁卯，木火水聚於元枵。

In the second month, on the day yichou, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Juzi for more than ten days, they gathered at Wei; On the day xinsi, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Jianglou for more than ten days. In the third month, on the day jihai, they gathered at Daliang for more than twenty days; On the day gengzi, they gathered at Lou for about ten days. In intercalary third month, on the day gengchen, Jupiter, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Daliang for more than twenty days; On the day xinsi, they gathered at Lou. In the fourth month, on the day dingyou, they gathered at Wei (Stomach); On the day gengzi, Jupiter and Mars shared longitude at 2° of Wei (Stomach). In the ninth month, on the day renshen, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 8° of Di.
87
六年十月庚辰，火金水聚於析木旬餘； 庚寅，聚於尾。 十一月壬申，土火金聚於元枵兩旬。 十二月戊子，土金同躔虛五度； 壬寅，土火水聚於元枵浹旬。
Year 6 of Yongzheng, in the tenth month, on the day gengchen, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Ximu for more than ten days; On the day gengyin, they gathered at Wei (Tail). In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, Saturn, Mars, and Venus gathered at Yuanxiao for twenty days. In the twelfth month, on the day wuzi, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 5° of Xu; On the day renyin, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao for about ten days.
88
七年正月乙丑，聚於危； 丙寅，火水同躔危十二度； 戊辰，土火水聚於娵訾旬餘。 五月乙卯，火金水聚於實沈； 癸亥，木水同躔井十度。 七月丙辰，木火金水聚於鶉首； 己未，聚於井。 閏七月丙子，木火同躔井二十六度； 丁亥，木火金聚於鶉火兩旬餘； 戊子，木金同躔井二十八度。
Year 7 of Yongzheng, in the first month, on the day yichou, they gathered at Wei; On the day bingyin, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 12° of Wei; On the day wuchen, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Juzi for more than ten days. In the fifth month, on the day yimao, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Sishen; On the day guihai, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 10° of Jing. In the seventh month, on the day bingchen, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou; On the day jiwei, they gathered at Jing. In intercalary seventh month, on the day bingzi, Jupiter and Mars shared longitude at 26° of Jing; On the day dinghai, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Quehuo for more than twenty days; On the day wuzi, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 28° of Jing.
89
八年正月辛巳，土金水聚於娵訾兩旬餘； 壬午，聚於危； 壬辰，土金同躔危十三度。 十二月丙申，火金水聚於元枵； 己未，土火水聚於娵訾旬餘，聚於危。
Year 8 of Yongzheng, in the first month, on the day xinsi, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Juzi for more than twenty days; On the day renwu, they gathered at Wei; On the day renchen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 13° of Wei. In the twelfth month, on the day bingshen, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao; On the day jiwei, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Juzi for more than ten days, they gathered at Wei.
90
九年正月丙寅，土火同躔室初度。 二月壬戌，土水同躔室七度。 三月壬辰，土金同躔室十度。 六月己酉，火金水聚於鶉首旬餘； 辛亥，聚於井浹旬。 七月甲戌，聚於鶉火旬餘； 己酉，木水同躔張十四度。 八月丙辰，木金同躔翼二度； 丁巳，木火金聚於鶉尾。
Year 9 of Yongzheng, in the first month, on the day bingyin, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at the first degree of Shi. In the second month, on the day renxu, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 7° of Shi. In the third month, on the day renchen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 10° of Shi. In the sixth month, on the day jiyou, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou for more than ten days; On the day xinhai, they gathered at Jing for about ten days. In the seventh month, on the day jiaxu, they gathered at Quehuo for more than ten days; On the day jiyou, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 14° of Zhang. In the eighth month, on the day bingchen, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 2° of Yi; On the day dingsi, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Quewei.
91
十年六月丙子，金水同躔張四度。
Year 10 of Yongzheng, in the sixth month, on the day bingzi, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 4° of Zhang.
92
十一年正月丙戌，土火同躔壁八度。 二月戊辰，土水同躔奎初度。 五月戊戌，火金水聚於鶉首； 己亥，聚於井旬餘； 甲辰，火金同躔井十六度； 己酉，火水同躔井二十度。 六月癸丑，金水同躔井二十七度； 辛酉，火金水聚於鶉火浹旬。
Year 11 of Yongzheng, in the first month, on the day bingxu, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 8° of Bi. In the second month, on the day wuchen, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at the first degree of Kui. In the fifth month, on the day wuxu, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou; On the day jihai, they gathered at Jing for more than ten days; On the day jiachen, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 16° of Jing; On the day jiyou, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 20° of Jing. In the sixth month, on the day guichou, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 27° of Jing; On the day xinyou, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quehuo for about ten days.

十二年二月甲寅，土金水聚於降婁旬餘； 丁卯，聚於奎； 丙子，土水同躔婁初度。 五月辛卯，土金同躔婁九度。 十一月辛巳，木金水聚於析木兩旬餘； 辛卯，聚於尾旬餘。
Year 12 of Yongzheng, in the second month, on the day jiayin, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Jianglou for more than ten days; On the day dingmao, they gathered at Kui; On the day bingzi, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at the first degree of Lou. In the fifth month, on the day xinmao, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 9° of Lou. 十三年正月庚子，金水同躔危九度。 二月己酉，土火同躔婁九度。 閏四月辛未，土水同躔胃六度； 壬辰，火金水聚於鶉首； 甲午，聚於井。 五月癸丑，聚於鶉火。 十月辛巳，聚於大火旬餘。 十二月癸酉，木水同躔鬥十九度。
Year 13 of Yongzheng, in the first month, on the day gengzi, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 9° of Wei. In the second month, on the day jiyou, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 9° of Lou. In intercalary fourth month, on the day xinwei, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 6° of Wei (Stomach); On the day renchen, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou; On the day jiawu, they gathered at Jing. In the fifth month, on the day guichou, they gathered at Quehuo. In the tenth month, on the day xinsi, they gathered at Dahuo for more than ten days. In the twelfth month, on the day guiyou, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 19° of Dou.

乾隆元年正月壬戌，木金同躔牛六度。 四月甲戌，土水同躔昴四度。 六月丙子，金水同躔井十七度。 九月乙卯，同躔氐十度。 十二月壬申，木金水聚於元枵。
The first year of Qianlong, in the first month, on the day renxu, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 6° of Niu. In the ninth month, on the day yimao, they shared longitude at 10° of Di. In the twelfth month, on the day renshen, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao.

二年二月辛酉，木水同躔危三度； 乙亥，土火同躔畢一度。 三月癸巳，土火金聚於實沈兩旬； 癸卯，土金同躔畢四度。 四月辛未，土金水聚於實沈； 戊寅，土水同躔畢八度； 癸未，土金水復聚實沈。 五月庚戌，土金同躔畢十二度。 七月丁亥朔，同躔觜一度。 閏九月壬戌，火金水聚於壽星。 十月丙戌，火水同躔氐三度； 丁亥，火金水聚於大火； 辛亥，聚於析木。 十一月乙卯，火金同躔心初度。 十二月辛亥，金水同躔女六度。

In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 12° of Bi (Net). In the seventh month, on the first day of the month (dinghai), they shared longitude at 1° of Zi. In intercalary ninth month, on the day renxu, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Shouxing. In the tenth month, on the day bingxu, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 3° of Di; On the day dinghai, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Dahuo; On the day xinhai, they gathered at Ximu. In the eleventh month, on the day yimao, Mars and Venus shared longitude at the first degree of Xin. In the twelfth month, on the day xinhai, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 6° of Nü.

三年二月丙申，木金水聚於降婁旬餘； 庚子，聚於壁。 三月乙亥，土金水聚於實沈兩旬餘。 四月癸巳，聚於觜； 戊戌，土金同躔觜七度。 十一月乙亥，金水同躔牛四度。
Year 3 of Qianlong, in the second month, on the day bingshen, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Jianglou for more than ten days; On the day gengzi, they gathered at Bi. In the third month, on the day yihai, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Sishen for more than twenty days. In the fourth month, on the day guisi, they gathered at Zi; On the day wuxu, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 7° of Zi. 四年二月乙巳，土火同躔井二度。 三月乙卯，木水同躔婁八度。 四月己亥，木金水聚於大梁旬餘。 八月丁丑，火水同躔翼十四度； 丙申，金水同躔翼初度。 九月癸丑，火金水聚於壽星； 癸酉，聚於大火旬有七日。 十月庚辰，聚於氐浹旬； 戊戌，聚於析木浹旬。 十一月壬申，金水同躔鬥十五度。 十二月壬辰，火水同躔鬥二度。
Year 4 of Qianlong, in the second month, on the day yisi, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 2° of Jing. In the third month, on the day yimao, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 8° of Lou. In the fourth month, on the day jihai, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Daliang for more than ten days. In the eighth month, on the day dingchou, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 14° of Yi; On the day bingshen, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at the first degree of Yi. In the ninth month, on the day guichou, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Shouxing; On the day guiyou, they gathered at Dahuo for 17 days. In the tenth month, on the day gengchen, they gathered at Di for about ten days; On the day wuxu, they gathered at Ximu for about ten days. In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 15° of Dou. In the twelfth month, on the day renchen, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 2° of Dou.

五年正月甲寅，同躔鬥十九度。 三月癸亥，木金同躔畢一度。 五月甲辰，土金同躔井二十度。 六月乙酉，土水同躔井二十四度。 閏六月戊申，金水同躔張三度。
Year 5 of Qianlong, in the first month, on the day jiayin, they shared longitude at 19° of Dou. In the third month, on the day guihai, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 1° of Bi (Net). In the fifth month, on the day jiachen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 20° of Jing. In the sixth month, on the day yiyou, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 24° of Jing. In intercalary sixth month, on the day wushen, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 3° of Zhang.

六年二月癸卯，土木火聚於井旬有八日。 三月己卯，土火同躔鬼初度。 五月庚午，木金水聚於鶉首旬餘； 癸酉，聚於井旬餘； 戊寅，木水同躔井十六度。 六月乙未，土金水聚於鶉火旬餘； 乙卯，復聚四日； 戊午，金水同躔星四度。 七月辛未，土木水聚於鶉火兩旬。 九月丁卯，火金水聚於大火； 己丑，聚於析木浹旬。
Year 6 of Qianlong, in the second month, on the day guimao, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars gathered at Jing for 18 days. In the third month, on the day jimao, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at the first degree of Gui. In the fifth month, on the day gengwu, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou for more than ten days; On the day guiyou, they gathered at Jing for more than ten days; On the day wuyin, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 16° of Jing. In the sixth month, on the day yiwei, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quehuo for more than ten days; On the day yimao, they gathered again for 4 days; On the day wuwu, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 4° of Xing. In the seventh month, on the day xinwei, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mercury gathered at Quehuo for twenty days. In the ninth month, on the day dingmao, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Dahuo; On the day jichou, they gathered at Ximu for about ten days.

七年三月庚申朔，火水同躔室六度； 庚午，火金水聚於室； 癸酉，聚於降婁兩旬，火金同躔室十五度； 戊寅，金水同躔室十四度； 乙酉，火水同躔壁九度。 五月癸未，土木水聚於鶉火月餘。 六月己丑，聚於柳兩旬餘； 壬寅，火水同躔畢五度。 七月乙酉，土木金水聚於鶉火。 八月戊子，土木水聚於星； 乙巳，土木金聚於星； 己酉，聚於鶉尾兩旬餘。 九月丙寅，聚於張。 十一月辛卯，土木火聚於鶉尾兩月； 庚午，聚於張月餘。 十二月戊子，土火同躔張四度； 甲寅，同躔張二度。
Year 7 of Qianlong, in the third month, on the first day of the month (gengshen), Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 6° of Shi; On the day gengwu, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Shi; On the day guiyou, they gathered at Jianglou for twenty days, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 15° of Shi; On the day wuyin, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 14° of Shi; On the day yiyou, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 9° of Bi. In the fifth month, on the day guiwei, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mercury gathered at Quehuo for more than a month. In the eighth month, on the day wuzi, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mercury gathered at Xing; On the day yisi, Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus gathered at Xing; On the day jiyou, they gathered at Quewei for more than twenty days. In the ninth month, on the day bingyin, they gathered at Zhang. In the eleventh month, on the day xinmao, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars gathered at Quewei two months; On the day gengwu, they gathered at Zhang for more than a month. In the twelfth month, on the day wuzi, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 4° of Zhang; On the day jiayin, they shared longitude at 2° of Zhang.
102
八年二月辛卯，金水同躔室二度。 五月戊子，土木火聚於張； 癸卯，土木火金聚於鶉尾； 乙巳，土木金聚於張旬餘。 七月戊子，土木水聚於鶉尾旬餘； 庚寅，聚於張。 八月癸亥，火金水聚於大火旬有七日； 甲戌，聚於氐。 九月壬午，金水同躔氐四度； 丁未，同躔亢二度。
Year 8 of Qianlong, in the second month, on the day xinmao, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 2° of Shi. In the fifth month, on the day wuzi, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars gathered at Zhang; On the day guimao, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Quewei; On the day yisi, Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus gathered at Zhang for more than ten days. In the eighth month, on the day guihai, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Dahuo for 17 days; On the day jiaxu, they gathered at Di. In the ninth month, on the day renwu, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 4° of Di; On the day dingwei, they shared longitude at 2° of Kang.
103
九年正月壬午，火水同躔危三度。 三月丁亥，火金水聚於降婁。 四月丁丑，火金同躔昴三度。 五月甲申，火金水聚於實沈旬餘； 乙未，金水同躔觜一度。 六月庚申，火金水聚於鶉首； 癸亥，聚於井。 七月庚寅，土金水聚於鶉尾旬餘； 癸巳，聚於張。 八月甲寅，木水同躔軫十度，木金水聚於壽星兩旬餘； 壬申，聚於角。 九月丙子，金水同躔角六度。
Year 9 of Qianlong, in the first month, on the day renwu, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 3° of Wei. In the third month, on the day dinghai, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Jianglou. In the fourth month, on the day dingchou, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 3° of Mao. In the ninth month, on the day bingzi, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 6° of Jiao.

十年二月己巳，土火同躔翼八度； 壬申，同躔翼七度。 四月己巳，同躔翼五度。 七月甲午，木火同躔亢六度。 八月壬寅，土水同躔翼十一度。 九月庚午朔，同躔翼十五度。 十月癸卯，土金水聚於壽星。

Year 11 of Qianlong, in the first month, on the day renshen, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 12° of Dou. In the twelfth month, on the first day of the month (renxu), Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 4° of Ji; On the day guiwei, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 11° of Dou; On the day bingxu, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Dou.

In the eleventh month, on the day xinchou, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Ximu for more than twenty days; On the day renzi, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 4° of Wei (Tail); On the day guichou, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Wei (Tail) for more than ten days; On the day bingchen, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 4° of Wei (Tail).
152
五十九年正月己丑朔，同躔鬥二十一度。 三月壬辰，同躔壁十三度； 丙辰，土金同躔胃三度。 四月癸未，土水同躔胃七度。 九月戊戌，木火金聚於析木； 癸卯，火金同躔尾十四度。 十月戊辰，木火金聚於星紀旬有七日； 壬申，木金同躔箕四度。 十二月壬戌，同躔鬥六度； 己巳，木金水聚於星紀； 庚辰，木水同躔鬥十度。
Year 59 of Qianlong, in the first month, on the first day of the month (jichou), they shared longitude at 21° of Dou. In the third month, on the day renchen, they shared longitude at 13° of Bi; On the day bingchen, Saturn and Venus shared longitude at 3° of Wei (Stomach). In the fourth month, on the day guiwei, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 7° of Wei (Stomach). In the ninth month, on the day wuxu, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Ximu; On the day guimao, Mars and Venus shared longitude at 14° of Wei (Tail). In the tenth month, on the day wuchen, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Xingji for 17 days; On the day renshen, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 4° of Ji. In the twelfth month, on the day renxu, they shared longitude at 6° of Dou; On the day jisi, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Xingji; On the day gengchen, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 10° of Dou.
153
六十年二月戊辰，木金同躔鬥二十一度。 三月戊辰，土火同躔昴四度。 四月乙酉，土火水聚於實沈旬有六日； 丁亥，土水同躔昴六度； 乙未，火水同躔畢十三度。 六月癸未，火金水聚於鶉首旬餘； 甲申，聚於井旬有八日； 己丑，火水同躔井二十二度； 癸卯，金水同躔井二十四度； 丙午，火金水聚於鶉火兩旬。 七月癸丑，聚於柳旬餘。 九月丙子，金水同躔氐十度。 十二月癸未，木金水聚於元枵浹旬； 癸巳，木水同躔女七度。
Year 60 of Qianlong, in the second month, on the day wuchen, Jupiter and Venus shared longitude at 21° of Dou. In the third month, on the day wuchen, Saturn and Mars shared longitude at 4° of Mao. In the fourth month, on the day yiyou, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered at Sishen for 16 days; On the day dinghai, Saturn and Mercury shared longitude at 6° of Mao; On the day yiwei, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 13° of Bi (Net). In the sixth month, on the day guiwei, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Queshou for more than ten days; On the day jiashen, they gathered at Jing for 18 days; On the day jichou, Mars and Mercury shared longitude at 22° of Jing; On the day guimao, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 24° of Jing; On the day bingwu, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Quehuo for twenty days. In the seventh month, on the day guichou, they gathered at Liu for more than ten days. In the ninth month, on the day bingzi, Venus and Mercury shared longitude at 10° of Di. In the twelfth month, on the day guiwei, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Yuanxiao for about ten days; On the day guisi, Jupiter and Mercury shared longitude at 7° of Nü.
